# NowFocus

> NowFocus is a privacy-first focus app for Android, macOS and Windows. It blocks distracting apps and sites during a focus session and makes quitting early a decision, not a reflex. Everything runs on the device; there is no account.

Status (2026-10-01): free, but not published to any store and no download links yet. Android has an early-access build (v0.3) and is furthest along; macOS is an early unreleased build; Windows is in development; iOS is planned. No cross-device sync yet. It is a self-control tool, not a lock: someone determined to uninstall it still can. There is a waitlist (email, platforms, optional feature request) on every page of the site; feature requests are posted publicly as GitHub issues, emails are not.
